scripts.// gen:client: openapi-typescript pins typescript@^5.x as a direct dependency, but this workspace pins typescript@7 for the app itself, so installing it as a devDependency makes the install fail on the peer conflict and a local-bin invocation would resolve to TS 7 and crash (ts.factory is undefined under the new API). `bunx --package` resolves its own dependencies outside the workspace tree, so it gets a real TS 5 and runs clean. The generated file is committed; apps/frontend/test/api-schema.test.ts fails if the spec moves without it.
